'''Nianla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] in the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], where she took custody of a set of stolen walker plans that had been recovered from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces that had stolen them.<ref name="TOR" />
